name: Passwordless Sudo
author: synjan
description: Shows when Omarchy's passwordless sudo is active, with a countdown in the bar and enable/extend/disable in the panel.

barWidget.description: Countdown for the omarchy-sudo-passwordless window, read from its transient systemd timer.

schema.label: Bar icon
schema.description: Nerd Font glyph shown in the bar.

schema.label: Default duration (minutes)
schema.description: Highlighted duration for the enable/extend buttons. omarchy-sudo-passwordless defaults to 15.

schema.label: Show while inactive
schema.description: Keep a dim glyph in the bar while passwordless sudo is off. Off hides the widget until it activates.

schema.label: Warn before expiry (seconds)
schema.description: Notification this long before the window closes. 0 disables the warning.
